svg.title: Amazon · Prime Video
svg.desc: An end-to-end TypeScript tool that audits every latency alarm in Prime Video's Apple fleet, recommends thresholds from each metric's own history and backtests them over weeks of real data. 1,991 latency alarms audited; 700+ could never fire; 74% of fired alerts were false alarms (approx.); Daily fleet-wide run, feeding a live dashboard. On-call ticket bot: when an alarm pages, it re-audits and comments recommended thresholds before the engineer opens the ticket Stays inside AWS Lambda limits with a per-segment rolling metric cache in S3, seeded by a sharded Step Functions backfill
